PASS_scope: Read-only primary-document and declared local metadata lineage review; not actual asset validation, newly generated supervision or training admission.

official_primary_sources.title: MR6D official author paper
sections: 3.2 Collection Environment and Process / Quality of annotations
official_primary_sources.facts: Euro pallet has manually designed mesh; Figure6 explicitly identifies Object1 as Euro Pallet. Validation uses RGB-D/camera trajectory and manually refined static object poses. Authors describe low-centimeter expected static annotation accuracy and few-centimeter Euro-pallet dimensional variation; these are not image-pixel error bounds. MR6D has no dedicated training set.
official_primary_sources.not_provided: Selected query-to-GT-instance or native8 endpoint labels, exact part mask, or a per-pixel registration guarantee.

official_primary_sources.title: Official MR6D release linked by author paper
official_primary_sources.facts: Official release host; main README body empty when read. Local pinned intake policy supplies version and named RGB/depth/mask/mask_visib/camera/pose/obj1 mesh provenance.
official_primary_sources.limit: No image or per-frame annotation link opened; names alone do not establish the exact MR6D visible-mask-generation algorithm or tolerance.

official_primary_sources.title: PoseCNN / original YCB-Video author toolbox
official_primary_sources.facts: Original meta.mat describes class IDs, camera intrinsics, depth conversion factor, object poses, and model-space coordinates per pixel. It is an object-pose dataset, not a pallet endpoint-visibility annotation contract.

official_primary_sources.title: Official YCB-Video class list
official_primary_sources.facts: The 21 listed classes include cans, boxes, wood block, drill, clamps and foam brick, with no pallet class. A YCB wood_block is not a pallet native corner.

official_primary_sources.title: Author toolbox annotation example
official_primary_sources.facts: Author code separately loads color, depth, class-label PNG and meta.mat, and projects model geometry using RT_o2c. This is not a release of arbitrary semantic surface-part labels.

official_primary_sources.title: Official BOP YCB-V dataset definition
official_primary_sources.facts: BOP YCB-V is a converted YCB-Video dataset. Its mesh units change meters to millimeters and model bounding-box centers become origins; GT poses are transformed consistently. Original/BOP mesh and pose conventions must not be mixed. Real training images and PBR training images are separate assets.

official_primary_sources.title: Official BOP format
official_primary_sources.facts: RGB and uint16 depth share frame IDs; depth_scale converts depth to mm. scene_gt has per-instance obj_id and model-to-camera pose. mask is object silhouette and mask_visib its visible part; IMID_GTID names use GT-list index. PLY models/translations use mm. Masks are optional in the general format. These fields do not name pallet parts.

official_primary_sources.title: Official BOP mask construction
official_primary_sources.facts: The script renders each GT object alone, converts scene/rendered depth to ray-distance images, stores full silhouette where rendered distance is positive, and derives visible silhouette with the visibility helper. Default delta15mm is a convention, not certified pose accuracy or selected-part truth.

official_primary_sources.title: Official BOP visible-surface predicate
official_primary_sources.facts: bop19 uses d_model>0 and (d_model-d_scene<=delta OR d_scene==0). Thus missing measured depth may be called visible, and the test is one-sided. bop18 instead requires both depths positive. Neither mode by itself identifies a semantic part or establishes physical external occlusion.

official_primary_sources.title: PoseCNN original dataset paper
official_primary_sources.facts: Initial manually set poses are depth-refined then trajectory/object poses globally optimized. Authors acknowledge RGB rolling shutter, model inaccuracies, RGB-depth asynchrony and calibration uncertainty. No per-query pixel bound is stated in the inspected text.

web_method: Official author papers, author toolbox text and official BOP docs/source read through web. No dataset image/depth/mask/pose/mesh/zip or model asset downloaded. CVF PDF direct fetch403; author arXiv HTML supplies complete text. Some pinned HF directory URLs unavailable to web tool; no release substitution.

provided_vs_required.authority: Available by YCB-V/BOP specification and MR6D author/intake metadata.
provided_vs_required.supports: A registered model-surface projection/depth-derived supervision proxy in a known source frame.
provided_vs_required.does_not_by_itself_prove: Which original initializer proposal corresponds to which GT-list instance or which native8 semantic part.

provided_vs_required.does_not_by_itself_prove: Per-material-end part identity, self-hidden surface visibility, exact native-corner position, or physical pixel-perfect gold. Amodal here is target-alone silhouette; it is not a projection of every hidden back surface.

minimum_conditions: Bind original SOURCE_DEVELOPMENT frame, GT-list instance index, obj_id, camera intrinsics, pose direction/units and matching mesh version. Preserve q/L/native/input flags and full original crop.

Declare a small material surface/triangle patch for the intended end in that mesh, separately from virtual box corner/ray or dynamic native role. Reuse the existing declared part convention when justified; do not demand exact physical-corner certification as a new user-goal barrier.

Render the full target alone so the selected patch contributes only where it is the target first surface. Same-pixel valid scene depth and selected-instance visible evidence can then support visibility; reliable closer distinct foreground evidence can support external-front occlusion.

Register RGB/depth/mask/camera conventions and preserve missing depth, uncertain instance/part association, self-hidden patch, truncation, boundary or registration disagreement as UNKNOWN. Do not treat missing-depth BOP19 visible pixels as confirmed selected-part visibility.

Intersect the declared patch with the unchanged original96 crop sampling grid, record visible and foreign-front masses separately; both can coexist. A center FOREIGN pixel or any pallet elsewhere in crop does not establish that endpoint external occlusion.
feasibility.not_a_new_pose_fit_requirement: Use supplied GT only as supervision geometry; no PnP, pose optimization, coordinate correction, GT-centered model inputs, or result-selected tolerance/permutation. Quantitative paper uncertainty is not converted to an invented pixel bound.
feasibility.practical_source_only_construction: A prospective operator may produce explicitly nominal/derived part-support targets from supplied mesh/pose + same-pixel depth under the above guards. Where selected material-end correspondence remains unsupported, keep UNKNOWN; a score-blind RGB structural coarse-region witness followed by a controlled cover/sham can instead give weak regional intervention support, clearly distinguished from native semantic gold. Neither construction is executed/admitted in this review.
feasibility.no_visible_negative_from_absence_alone: No patch sample/OOF/self-hidden/missing correspondence is not native E. Negative support only follows the frozen defined observable support domain; unresolved absence stays UNKNOWN.

important_semantic_caveats: BOP mask_visib generation is depth-derived with a visibility convention, not independent manual selected-part truth. The exact existing MR6D mask-generation mode/tolerance was not established by the inspected release README; generic BOP code cannot silently certify it.
Original YCB and BOP-converted coordinates differ. Instance ID is GT-list position; obj_id is class/model identity and cannot replace instance selection.
MR6D nominal Euro CAD and low-centimeter expected static accuracy enable useful nominal supervision, but do not justify <=3px gold or exact physical surface/corner location for every sample.
Whole-pallet masks, literal central2x2 owner, crop-any-target presence, selected-end regional support, self-occlusion and native semantic visibility remain different targets.
No new assessment of current/private human semantic annotation authority is made; source geometry uncertainty does not revoke that existing authority.
Official YCB classes contain no pallet, MR6D obj1 is nominal Euro pallet, and Pallox is a bin; none alone closes all WOOD/SQUARE/native8 supervision scope.
